GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. back to 3rd 800 metres. forced out 3 Wide 800 metres. hard ridden turn 2 lengths. weakened # covered ground
Jumped Ok worked around to settle 4th 2 lengths. joined leaders turn 3 wide. weakened in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped Well sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in abruptly and made contact.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 5th 4 lengths over racing. looking for run turn 3 lengths. battled away when clear # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in. Passing the 1000m, after over-racing for some distance when the pace slackened, got its head up when being restrained and lost some ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 7l off, under whip turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 1kg over allotted weight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th early. went around to settle outside leader 1200 metres. gone turn. weakened # went early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start and made contact with rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat back 7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages. Passing 900m was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened late # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. shared lead turn. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Checked near 300m to avoid heels of rnr which shifted out when not clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. got up fence turn 2 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary of the mare, which had not raced for in excess of 150 days, passed it fit to race. Began awkwardly. Momentarily eased from heels near the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off but 3 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly shifted in and bumped another runner. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
